description: React Native component for displaying, managing, and exporting debug logs within the Notesnook mobile app. Includes functions for viewing logs, copying, downloading, and clearing them, with UI elements and interactions.

methods.name: renderItem
methods.description: Renders individual log message with color coding and long-press copy functionality.

methods.name: downloadLogs
methods.description: Exports current log messages to a text file, handling platform-specific storage.

methods.name: copyLogs
methods.description: Copies current log messages to clipboard.

methods.name: clearLogs
methods.description: Clears current logs after user confirmation dialog.
